hero.label: GIA — DIGITAL MARKETING ADVISORY
hero.headline: We Start With The Business.
hero.intro: GIA Marketing House is a company specializing in digital marketing and growth, established as an extension of GIA – Guide House for Investment & Advisory. It provides integrated consulting and solutions across digital marketing, lead generation, customer relationship management (CRM), marketing automation, and business growth.

pillars.title: Business-First Thinking
pillars.description: We begin every engagement by understanding the business, not by pitching a predefined package of services. The objective comes first; the channels and tactics are chosen to serve it.

pillars.title: Strategy Before Execution
pillars.description: A marketing strategy should be able to explain why a channel is being used, not just that it is. We build that reasoning first, then execute against it — across digital marketing, social media, and performance marketing.

pillars.title: Connected Marketing
pillars.description: Lead generation, CRM, and conversion are not separate workstreams added to a campaign. We build them as one connected system, so every lead has a clear path, a defined follow-up process, and a structured journey from first contact to conversion.

pillars.title: Sustainable Growth
pillars.description: We're focused on growth that compounds — built on measurement, learning, and continuous improvement — rather than a single campaign spike that doesn't hold.

closing.headline: Let's Talk About Your Business.
closing.body: If you'd like to talk through where your business is today, where you want it to go, and what you're trying to solve, we're glad to start with the conversation.
